units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Locked-off low close-up on bare empty asphalt. The road holds two pairs of feet alone, four shoes and only four shoes in the whole frame, the rest of the road is bare grey asphalt. Four shoes step along the faded white centre line in a counting rhythm, dusk dust lifting at each contact, the white paint bright underfoot. The camera stays still on the ground, the stepping alone carries the frame. 35mm film grain, warm dusk telecine palette. LIT_BY_DUSK. 2001 Taiwan music video look
